sections.title: Habit and habitat
sections.text: Cyclamen coum is a small tuberous perennial native from Bulgaria to the Caucasus and Levant. It grows about 10 cm tall and wide. Its rounded leaves may be silver-marbled; pink, red or white flowers appear in winter and are about 2 cm across.

sections.title: Flowering and toxicity
sections.text: After flowering, the fruit stalk coils into a spiral. The plate matches the round leaves, reflexed petals and coiled stalk. The tuber should not be eaten, and cyclamens can be toxic to pets.
